name: element.tree
description: Recursive UIA TreeWalker descent from the given element. Returns a flat list with depth markers (Option 13 §D form — strict-mode-friendly).

handle.description: Root element handle (`elt:N` form). Use a window-root id from element.list, or descend from a previously-found element.

depth.description: Maximum traversal depth from the root (0 = root only, 1 = root + direct children, …). Default 5. Covers most single-window dialogs without runaway descent into complex apps. Use `full: true` to raise the internal cap to 12.

full.description: When true: raises the depth cap to 12, removes the element count cap (default 200), and includes `value` and `flags` on each element instead of the compact defaults (id, role, name, bounds).

depth.description: Distance from the root (0 = root itself, 1 = direct child, etc.).

automation_id.description: UIA AutomationId. Empty string when the element doesn't expose one.

flags.description: Universally-determinable UIA boolean states currently true on the element. Per issue #92.

elements.description: Pre-order traversal: root first, then each subtree in turn. Reconstruct the tree client-side via `depth` (entries with depth d+1 immediately following depth d are the children of the most-recent depth-d entry).

truncated.description: Present and true when the walk was stopped early by the depth cap or element count cap. Absent (or false) when the full subtree was returned. Signal to callers to use `depth` or `full: true` if more detail is needed.

x-implementations.name: uia_tree_walker
x-implementations.description: UIA `IUIAutomation::CreateTreeWalker` (raw-view condition). Recursive descent emitting depth-tagged entries; `max_depth` short-circuits the walk.

windows-modern.description: UIA TreeWalker with raw-view condition (visits all elements, not just content-filtered). Allocates fresh elt:N ids for each element returned. UIPI applies — descent through an IL barrier returns ERR uia_blind on the first inaccessible element.
